Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1069
Claimant:
Jose Shields
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
02/09/2024
Claim reported by the claimant after a low-speed head-on collision with another vehicle. The driver is named on the
policy, and the claimant reports a knee injury and is not represented by a lawyer.
02/14/2024
Reviewed the police report, which confimrs the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene. The responding officer's
notes match the account given at intake.
03/02/2024
Photos from the scene and the repair shop show damage mostly consistent with the described impact. Some details
in the photos line up with the claimant's description.
03/04/2024
No independent witnesses have come forward, so the file relies on photos, the police report, and the claimant's
statements.
04/03/2024
Called the claimant to take a recorded statement. The account given matches what was told at first notice of loss,
with no chanegs in the sequence of events.
04/13/2024
Medical records show a knee injury that fits the kind and force of this crash. No prior injury to the same area is known
from the claimant's history or available records.
04/28/2024
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this type of knee injury. Requested updated treatment
notes and a therapy plan to understand the reasons for the extended course.
06/02/2024
Checked the vehicle history. No earlier damage to the insured vehicle is on record, though a neighbor has mentioned
seeing the car damaged a few weeks bfeore the reported loss. Following up with the neighbor for more detail.
06/07/2024
Spoke with the neighbor, who could not confirm the timing of the damage they recalled seeing. Noted that the
recollection is unclear and will be weighed against the other evidence.
08/02/2024
Reviewed the claimant's statements from each contact. The claimant has given the same account every time, and the
file is otherwise consistent with a low-speed collision.
08/19/2024
Reserves reviewed and the file remains open pending the treatment update and the outcome of the vehicle
inspection. The next step is to confirm the repair estimate and the meidcal timeline before a settlement position is set.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
